businessDecisionBody: recording an Outcome is a business decision of the decision owner, or of the owner's active delegate, inside this product. It is not an engineering delivery gate.

forums.title: Forums
forums.intro: The five layers of the transformation operating system with their cadence, purpose, participants and outputs, and each forum's agenda rules.
forums.customForum: A forum added for this transformation (no playbook source text).
forums.arProvisional: Provisional Arabic translation of the playbook text; the English source is shown below each line.

participants.title: Participants
participants.intro: People and groups invited to this forum's meetings, and whether they count for the quorum.

series.title: Meeting series
series.intro: The recurrence that generates this forum's meetings on the business calendar.
series.none: No active series: meetings are created one by one.
series.intervalHint: 1 = every week (or day or month), 2 = every second one.
series.confirmFutureHint: Today's and past meetings, and future meetings that already have agenda items, attendance or minutes, are kept.
series.futureOnly: Future meetings only: a change cancels future scheduled meetings that have no content and generates the new dates. Today's and past meetings, and future meetings with content, are kept.
series.createdBody: {{count}} meeting(s) were generated on the new recurrence; they are listed on the Meetings page.
series.noCalendar: No meetings were generated: the organization has no business calendar for working days.

nwd.next_working_day: Move to the next working day

series.confirmFutureOption: I understand: only future meetings change

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.intro: Meetings of this transformation's forums, generated by a series or created one by one.
meetings.emptyBody: Create a series on a forum, or create one meeting.

meeting.title: Meeting

cancelReason.series_regenerated: Cancelled when the series changed (future meeting without content)

meeting.frozen: This meeting is {{status}}: its agenda, attendance, outputs and actions can no longer be changed.

agenda.title: Agenda
agenda.intro: Items are drafted, then published by the chair. An executive ask needs all seven elements before it can be published.
agenda.asksOnlyIntro: Escalate decisions, not status: this forum's agenda takes executive asks only, each with all seven elements.

ask.intro: An executive ask states the decision required, why now, the options, the recommendation, the impact of delay, the decision owner and the required date.
ask.optionsHint: One option per line; at least two. They become options A, B, C …
ask.recommendationHint: Write the recommendation, or the letter of one option (A, B …) to recommend that option.

outputs.title: Meeting outputs
outputs.intro: The outputs of this meeting, each linked to its record where it has one.
outputs.required: The minutes can be published only with at least one of: {{outputs}}.
outputs.recordIdHint: The ID of the record in this transformation.

minutes.title: Minutes
minutes.intro: Minutes are drafted, approved by the chair, then published. Published minutes are read-only.

actions.title: Meeting actions
actions.intro: Actions assigned in this meeting; each appears in its owner's My Work. Overdue actions are flagged.

blockers.title: Blocker status
blockers.intro: The RAG of each blocker in this meeting's cycle. A blocker red for the configured number of cycles raises one executive ask.

decisions.title: Executive decision log (T16)
decisions.intro: Executive asks of this transformation with their options, recommendation, owner, decision date, impact of delay and outcome.
decisions.tableIntro: An earlier record (before this log existed) shows Unknown for the columns it does not have.
decisions.earlierRecord: an earlier record without this column

escalations.intro: Executive asks past their SLA date are escalated once per date to the next authority, with the impact of delay. Routing errors are shown, never skipped.
escalations.title: Decision escalations

routingError.party_unmapped: Routing error: no person mapped to this role
routingError.party_not_executive: Routing error: the mapped person is not an executive
routingError.no_next_authority: Routing error: no next authority in the chain

rules.title: Escalation rules
rules.intro: A rule marked Default uses the built-in setting until it is saved for this transformation.
rules.defaultIntro: This rule uses the default. Saving it stores it for this transformation.
rules.chainHint: Governance role codes in order, separated by commas, e.g. SP.
